ANIL RATHO +91 9391698844 | anil.ratho4891@gmail.com | Hyderabad | MBA - Innovation Management

Enterprise Transformation Leader – Banking & Financial Services Driving enterprise-scale business and operating model transformation across global banking environments, translating strategy into execution through structured programs, governance frameworks, and digital enablement. .

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

Transformation & Program Delivery Leader with 17+ years of experience driving enterprise transformation initiatives across global banking and GCC environments. Experienced in leading end-to-end transformation programs spanning operating model redesign, process re-engineering, automation adoption, and performance improvement.

Delivered USD 1.86M in cost optimization, ~20% performance uplift, and up to 55% efficiency gains through structured transformation programs, disciplined program governance, and data-driven execution.

Driving responsible adoption of AI-enabled capabilities by establishing governance frameworks, execution models, and guardrails that support scalable and compliant integration of AI into enterprise workflows.

Trusted partner to senior stakeholders, translating strategic priorities into executable transformation roadmaps and leading cross-functional teams to deliver measurable and sustainable business outcomes.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Business Transformation • Program & Project Management

Transformation PMO

Operating Model

Transformation • Process Excellence • Continuous Improvement

Process Re-engineering • Automation & Digitization • Change Management

CAREER HIGHLIGHTS

Delivered 15–22% productivity gains and 20–25% TAT reduction through workflow simplification and process

transformation initiatives.

Collaborated on AI governance and Prompt Engineering frameworks to enable responsible enterprise AI



adoption Led large-scale operating model transformation initiatives, improving productivity, process efficiency, and service performance.

Drove workflow automation transformation across disputes, KYC, claims, refunds, and reconciliations using

PEGA, RPA, STP, and Adobe Sign.

Built regional analytics and reporting platform, integrating multi-system data to enable data-driven decision

making across APAC banking operations.

CERTIFICATIONS

Certified Project Management Professional (PMP®) • Lean Six Sigma – Black Belt • Certified Scrum Master (CSM®) • • Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO®) • AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner TECHNICAL SKILLS

SAS, R, Power BI, Tableau, SQL, VBA and Python

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

VP – Lead Control Management Officer - Wells Fargo - Oct 2022 to Present • Executed enterprise control evaluation activities, partnering with business, risk, and compliance stakeholders to

assess control testing effectiveness and strengthen risk monitoring across critical banking processes.

Diagnosed structural control design gaps during QA reviews and implemented sustainable process improvements to improve control reliability and reduce recurrence of control weaknesses.

Automated QA workbook validation using VBA, eliminating manual errors and field mismatches across multi- sheet testing workbooks and improving accuracy and efficiency of QA reviews.

Developed VBA-based decision support tools, embedding business logic to enable faster and more consistent



evaluation of control testing outcomes. Implemented centralized SharePoint-based QA tracking, enabling real-time visibility into QA sample completion, observations, and testing progress.

Contributing to AI governance and Prompt Engineering for Control Management defining usage standards, control frameworks, and operating guardrails to enable safe and effective adoption of AI-driven capabilities.

AVP – HSBC - Mar 2019 to Oct 2022 •

Spearheaded large-scale service transformation initiatives across global teams (1,000+ FTEs), improving delivery resilience, performance consistency, and customer outcomes. Transformed customer experience transformation through process excellence and service improvement initiatives.



Optimized operating models through data-driven organizational design, improving productivity and capacity utilization.

Delivered cost transformation initiatives, improving operational efficiency while sustaining service performance. Implemented process automation and digitization initiatives, improving cycle times and efficiency across • banking workflows.

Developed enterprise performance dashboards and transformation metrics to support data-driven decision



making. Institutionalized transformation governance frameworks enabling structured execution of cross-functional change programs.

Manager – HSBC - May 2017 to Feb 2019 • Diagnosed systemic performance gaps and led targeted operational improvements by translating large-scale KPI



•



and productivity insights into process and workforce interventions. Enabled accurate demand forecasting and optimized resource allocation through volume analysis and production planning. Enabled data-driven capacity optimization through volume analytics and demand forecasting. Improved process governance and operational stability across card operations through structured process improvements. Led 240+ contact center and back-office staff, re-engineering processes to improve customer experience, governance, and cost efficiency.

Assistant Manager – HSBC - May 2013 to Apr 2017 • Delivered end-to-end process transitions and standardization initiatives, improving controls, compliance, and



operational efficiency across cards and loans servicing. Improved accuracy, turnaround time, and compliance with card network standards by streamlining fraud monitoring, reconciliation, and dispute resolution processes for Visa and MasterCard.

Streamlined fraud monitoring, reconciliation, and dispute processes, improving accuracy and turnaround time



across card network operations. Led a 40+ member team of MI Analysts, SMEs and complaint handlers managing card transaction disputes, consistently tracking KPIs and performance metrics to meet and exceed agreed service-level standards.

Early Career – Operations - HSBC – Dec 2008 to Apr 2013 • Subject Matter Expert – Training & Quality Assurance - Nov 2010 – Apr 2013 • Complaints Resolution - Nov 2009 – Oct 2010 • Processing Executive - Dec 2008 – Nov 2009

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
VP – Lead Control Management Officer - Wells Fargo - Oct 2022 to Present • Executed enterprise control evaluation activities, partnering with business, risk, and compliance stakeholders to
assess control testing effectiveness and strengthen risk monitoring across critical banking processes.
Diagnosed structural control design gaps during QA reviews and implemented sustainable process improvements to improve control reliability and reduce recurrence of control weaknesses.
Automated QA workbook validation using VBA, eliminating manual errors and field mismatches across multi- sheet testing workbooks and improving accuracy and efficiency of QA reviews.
Developed VBA-based decision support tools, embedding business logic to enable faster and more consistent

evaluation of control testing outcomes. Implemented centralized SharePoint-based QA tracking, enabling real-time visibility into QA sample completion, observations, and testing progress.
Contributing to AI governance and Prompt Engineering for Control Management defining usage standards, control frameworks, and operating guardrails to enable safe and effective adoption of AI-driven capabilities.
AVP – HSBC - Mar 2019 to Oct 2022 •
Spearheaded large-scale service transformation initiatives across global teams (1,000+ FTEs), improving delivery resilience, performance consistency, and customer outcomes. Transformed customer experience transformation through process excellence and service improvement initiatives.

Optimized operating models through data-driven organizational design, improving productivity and capacity utilization.
Delivered cost transformation initiatives, improving operational efficiency while sustaining service performance. Implemented process automation and digitization initiatives, improving cycle times and efficiency across • banking workflows.
Developed enterprise performance dashboards and transformation metrics to support data-driven decision

making. Institutionalized transformation governance frameworks enabling structured execution of cross-functional change programs.
Manager – HSBC - May 2017 to Feb 2019 • Diagnosed systemic performance gaps and led targeted operational improvements by translating large-scale KPI

•

and productivity insights into process and workforce interventions. Enabled accurate demand forecasting and optimized resource allocation through volume analysis and production planning. Enabled data-driven capacity optimization through volume analytics and demand forecasting. Improved process governance and operational stability across card operations through structured process improvements. Led 240+ contact center and back-office staff, re-engineering processes to improve customer experience, governance, and cost efficiency.
Assistant Manager – HSBC - May 2013 to Apr 2017 • Delivered end-to-end process transitions and standardization initiatives, improving controls, compliance, and

operational efficiency across cards and loans servicing. Improved accuracy, turnaround time, and compliance with card network standards by streamlining fraud monitoring, reconciliation, and dispute resolution processes for Visa and MasterCard.
Streamlined fraud monitoring, reconciliation, and dispute processes, improving accuracy and turnaround time

across card network operations. Led a 40+ member team of MI Analysts, SMEs and complaint handlers managing card transaction disputes, consistently tracking KPIs and performance metrics to meet and exceed agreed service-level standards.
Early Career – Operations - HSBC – Dec 2008 to Apr 2013 • Subject Matter Expert – Training & Quality Assurance - Nov 2010 – Apr 2013 • Complaints Resolution - Nov 2009 – Oct 2010 • Processing Executive - Dec 2008 – Nov 2009
